name: The Recruit
description: Recruited out of law school by the CIA, a daredevil young attorney leaps unprepared into the dangerous world of international espionage.

videos.title: I.N.A.S.I.A.L.
videos.overview: Thrown into the deep end during his first week at the CIA, rookie lawyer Owen Hendricks quickly gets in over his head when he uncovers a possible threat.

videos.title: N.L.T.S.Y.P.
videos.overview: While scrambling to learn how to navigate the high-stakes world of international espionage, Owen attempts to track down classified information on Max.

videos.title: Y.D.E.K.W.Y.D.
videos.overview: Owen's crash course in CIA protocols continues as he negotiates with Max, goes on a date with a co-worker and contends with a hostile agency employee.

videos.title: I.Y.D.I.A.A.C.
videos.overview: When a major snag jeopardizes Max's case, Owen races to find a legal loophole — and urges her not to take matters into her own ruthless hands.

videos.title: T.S.L.A.Y.P.
videos.overview: Owen's plan to move on from Max suffers a setback when he's ordered back to Phoenix, where credit cards and prying eyes cause problems at work and home.

videos.title: I.C.I.N.C.
videos.overview: On the heels of his risky negotiations on Max's behalf, Owen faces uncomfortable questions from his colleagues — and friends — about their connection.

videos.title: I.M.F.T.B.S.
videos.overview: A mission to Geneva to retrieve assets from a Swiss bank account spirals into chaos for Owen and Max, while Hannah's mom pressures her for information.

videos.title: W.T.F.I.O.H.
videos.overview: The mission with Max takes a dangerous turn as complications arise, bullets fly — and Owen's personal and professional lives collide.

videos.title: Y.N.A.H.Y.A.L.
videos.overview: After the chaos in Prague, Owen gets benched. But it's not long before he stumbles on a new case — and into a new den of spies in South Korea.

videos.title: Y.A.R.A.C.O.T.D.O.P.
videos.overview: Owen becomes a human target while digging deeper into the graymail case. Nichka has major intel on a kidnapping — but it won't come for free.

videos.title: H.H.I.I.T.K.A.L.
videos.overview: An impromptu trip to the Middle East leads to danger. Jang Kyun takes extreme measures to get the answers he seeks.

videos.title: A.T.N.W.H.Y.P.A.B.H.
videos.overview: With no one else to trust, Owen and Jang Kyun reluctantly team up. Hannah's new romance proves risky. Oliver arranges a meeting with the yakuza.

videos.title: W.S.T.W.T.P.
videos.overview: Owen and his cohorts race to evade capture when the NIS orders their arrest. To save her own skin, Dawn agrees to lead a perilous mission.

videos.title: I.D.N.W.T.B.D.I.
videos.overview: Forced to pivot when an operation goes sideways, Owen must rely on new allies, old friends and his own resourcefulness to even the odds.
